lines.zh: 幽郁体飘过，草地结出水珠。
lines.en: As this vex drifts past, dew beads on the grass.

lines.zh: 身体小，翅膀破得像湿纸。
lines.en: I'm small, and my wings are ragged as wet paper.

lines.zh: 我身边的海水跟着我转。
lines.en: Seawater swirls where I go.
Water vapor trails behind me, wetting the way.
I slip through a gap in the wall.
Drip by drip, I go along.

lines.zh: 我贴着房梁飘，从上往下看。
lines.en: I drift along the beams, looking down.
My shape isn't steady. It comes apart.

lines.zh: 我飞过的地方，火把会熄。
lines.en: Torches go out where I pass.
Now quick, now slow.
I drift toward your back.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇不动，可我在飞。
lines.en: My wings don't beat, yet I fly.
The wind off the sea pushes me along.
I circle the house, looking for a way in.

lines.zh: 我落地时，地上有一圈水。
lines.en: When I land, a ring of water appears.

lines.zh: 我循着火把的光往村子飘。
lines.en: I drift toward the torchlight of a village.
I hover, dripping slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脸看不清，本来就模糊。
lines.en: My face is unclear. It always was.
I'm listening to the breathing inside.

lines.zh: 翅膀抖了一下，掉了点水。
lines.en: My wings twitch and shed a little water.

lines.zh: 海在远处叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: The sea calls far off and I answer.

lines.zh: 我在墙上留下一道湿印。
lines.en: I leave a wet streak on the wall.

lines.zh: 我数着屋子里有几个人。
lines.en: I'm counting how many people are inside.
Light passes through me.
I fade slowly, then come back.
I raise a hand; my fingers drip.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可我在喘。
lines.en: I don't need to breathe, and I'm panting.

lines.zh: 夜深了，我贴在屋檐下滴水。
lines.en: Deep in the night I cling under the eaves, dripping.

lines.zh: 地上的水，慢慢围成一个圈。
lines.en: The water on the floor slowly forms a ring.
I laugh, and it sounds like air escaping.
A vex's wings, wet with seawater.
Can you make out my face?
The wall behind you is seeping.
I'm small, and I'm not easy to deal with.
That torch in your hand is nearly out.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的头飞，别转头。
lines.en: I circle your head. Don't turn.

lines.zh: 你身上有海的味道，很淡。
lines.en: You have the sea's smell on you, faintly.
Vexes burst; so do seaborn.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边了，没有路了。
lines.en: You've backed to the wall. No way left.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，水会往下滴。
lines.en: When I smile, the water drips.
I scatter, then gather again.
Water splashes off me.
My shape got knocked crooked.
This pain won't stay with me long.
I retreat to the corner, dripping.
Where you struck, there was nothing.
I've thinned out. I need to condense again.
I can't laugh now.
The sea will fill me back in.

lines.zh: 你别停手，反正也杀不死我。
lines.en: Don't stop on my account. You can't kill me anyway.
That thing in your hand is shiny.
Set it down. Let me look.
I don't eat. I just want it.
Has that touched seawater?
A little closer. Just a little.
The moment you let go, I'll take it.
This little thing, for your life.
Hold it steady. Don't shake.
I reach out and water leaks between my fingers.
Give it to me and I'll go.
You run into a cold, wet mass.

lines.zh: 被撞散的水滴，一颗颗粘回来。
lines.en: The scattered droplets stick back one by one.
That soaked your sleeve through.

lines.zh: 我退开，水在地上留下圆印。
lines.en: I withdraw and leave a round mark on the floor.

lines.zh: 我半个身子是透明的海水。
lines.en: Half of my body is transparent seawater.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，你能感觉到凉。
lines.en: I press close and you feel the cold.

lines.zh: 别碰，我身上的海嗣肉会爆。
lines.en: Do not touch; the seaborn flesh on me will burst.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，慢慢正回来。
lines.en: The bump knocks me crooked and I slowly straighten.

lines.zh: 水从我身上溅到你脸上。
lines.en: Water splashes from me onto your face.
We pass each other and neither stops.
The seaborn don't pair off.

lines.zh: 我们只是一个念头，重复很多次。
lines.en: We're one thought, repeated many times.
Another me is in the water.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，合成更浓的一团。
lines.en: We press together into a thicker mass.
Then we part and go our separate ways.

lines.zh: 我们没有名字，也不需要。
lines.en: We have no names, and no need of them.

lines.zh: 海把我们造出来，又收回去。
lines.en: The sea makes us and takes us back.
You're asking the wrong thing.

lines.zh: 我们没有幼体，只有扩散。
lines.en: We have no young. Only spread.
There's some of it in you now too.

lines.zh: 我用湿手接住，它变凉了。
lines.en: I catch it in a wet hand and it goes cold.
It seeps water in my hand.
I take it and hide it in the water.

lines.zh: 这东西，会变成海的一部分。
lines.en: This will become part of the sea.
I'm keeping it. No returns.
It's slippery; I nearly dropped it.

lines.zh: 我把它压进水里，它沉了。
lines.en: I push it under and it sinks.
This isn't enough.
I've taken it. Don't reach for it.
I smile and back off, and the thing is gone.
You're under the lamp. Easy to find.

lines.zh: 你喘一下，水气就偏了方向。
lines.en: One breath from you and the mist shifts.
I've fixed on you, from above.

lines.zh: 屋里的水，开始往你那边流。
lines.en: The water in the room is flowing toward you.
I'm in no hurry. I'm faster than you.
This corner has no way out.
First I'll put your torch out.
Now you can't see me.
I'm right at your left ear.
Don't move. I'm very close.

lines.zh: 咸水在我周围转成小漩涡。
lines.en: Salt water swirls into a small vortex around me.
Every time you look back, I've switched sides.

lines.zh: 水在我脚下积成一小滩。
lines.en: Water pools in a small puddle under me.
I'm waiting for you to lower your hand.
You can't hear me. I make no sound.

lines.zh: 屋里的灯，我一盏一盏灭。
lines.en: I put out the lamps one by one.
You've backed to the table.
I can feel the heat off you.

lines.zh: 你一停，我的水手就搭上肩。
lines.en: When you stop, my watery hand finds your shoulder.
How far did you count? I'm at three.
I press close and the cold goes into your bones.
I claw and your arm comes away wet.
One lunge and you're falling back.
Your skin is starting to pale.

lines.zh: 我笑起来，水从嘴里流下。
lines.en: I laugh and water runs from my mouth.
I come around behind and claw once.
You hit me and I scatter into mist.

lines.zh: 我又聚回来，就在你面前。
lines.en: I gather again, right in front of you.

lines.zh: 我身上滴下的水，能烧穿甲。
lines.en: The water dripping off me eats through armour.

lines.zh: 愠怒的我一撞，就往后退开。
lines.en: I slam into you in my rage, then dart back.
I condense out of the water vapor.
This room is far too damp.

lines.zh: 我先是一团湿，然后才有了形。
lines.en: First I'm a wetness, then I take a shape.
The mold in the corner came with me.
The sound of the sea comes from me.
I drift to the lamp and it dims.
A small puddle appears on the floor.
Someone is asleep in this house.
I count them. Three in all.
I rise slowly and look first.
The fire bakes me and I shrink by half.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，落地是一摊水。
lines.en: I fall and land as a splash of water.

lines.zh: 我本来就是水，可我在溺。
lines.en: I'm made of water, and I'm drowning.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我吹散了一遍。
lines.en: The blast blows me apart once.

lines.zh: 箭穿过来，在我身上开了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes and leaves a hole in me.
This spell pins me in midair.

lines.zh: 这里太干，我一点点薄下去。
lines.en: It's too dry here; I thin out by degrees.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，我亮了一下就散。
lines.en: Lightning hits me; I flash and scatter.
There isn't even vapor here.
